attchmntText: W S Industries (I) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on outcome of Board Meeting held on 12.11.2026.
voiceSummary: W.S. Industries Board approved direct acquisition of 54.8950 acres of land in Sriperumbudur. The Board also approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 0.03 Crores for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 24.05 Crores in the same period last year. The company reported a loss of 2.03 Crores for the quarter, versus a profit of 0.23 Crores previously. Half-year revenue was 0.46 Crores against 50.10 Crores last year, with a half-year loss of 0.27 Crores versus a profit of 1.46 Crores. Earnings per share were negative 0.29 for the quarter and negative 0.06 for the half year. The auditor noted nominal operational revenue and a going concern basis. A further Board meeting is scheduled for 18th November 2026.
